story_info.title: Bella Bear Helps Squeaky Squirrel
story_info.subtitle: A kind helper in Blossom Meadow.
story_info.moral: It feels good to help friends and show kindness.

main_character.name: Bella Bear
main_character.appearance: Bella is a small, round brown bear cub with soft honey-colored fur, warm dark eyes, and a gentle smile. She has a little cream-colored tummy patch and short rounded ears.

supporting_characters.name: Squeaky Squirrel
supporting_characters.appearance: A small grey squirrel with a bushy tail and bright eyes.
supporting_characters.role: Needs help carrying heavy nuts for winter.

slides.title: Bella's Morning Walk
slides.text: Bella Bear loved sunny mornings. She walked in Blossom Meadow. Golden sunshine warmed her soft fur. Many pretty flowers grew all around. Birds sang sweet, happy songs. Bella felt a deep joy inside. Then she saw her friend, Squeaky Squirrel. But Squeaky looked a little sad today.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Bella Bear walking happily in Blossom Meadow on a sunny morning, then seeing Squeaky Squirrel looking sad.

slides.title: Squeaky's Big Problem
slides.text: "Hello, Squeaky!" Bella smiled softly. "Why do you look so glum today?" Squeaky pointed with his tiny paw. A very big pile of nuts sat there. "These are for my winter food," he said. "But they are too many and too heavy for me! I cannot carry them all home."
slides.speaker_notes: Squeaky Squirrel explains his problem to Bella Bear, pointing to a large pile of nuts he cannot carry.

slides.title: Bella's Kind Idea
slides.text: Bella felt a little sad for Squeaky. She saw his worried little face. Bella knew how it felt to need help. She thought of a kind way to help him. Bella smiled a warm, gentle smile. "Do not worry, dear friend!" she said. "Kind hearts make happy days! I can help you carry them."
slides.speaker_notes: Bella Bear shows empathy, understands Squeaky's problem, and offers to help him with a kind smile.

slides.title: Working Together
slides.text: Bella bent down with care. She used her strong paws. Bella gently picked up a big pile of nuts. Her paws held them very easily. Squeaky picked up his own smaller pile. "Thank you, Bella!" he chirped happily. Together, they walked towards Squeaky's cozy home. They walked slow and steady, side by side.
slides.speaker_notes: Bella Bear and Squeaky Squirrel work together, carrying the nuts towards Squeaky's home, showing teamwork.

slides.title: Happy Hearts
slides.text: Soon, all the nuts were safe inside Squeaky's home. Squeaky Squirrel was so happy! He gave Bella a big, warm hug. "You are the best friend!" he said truly. Bella felt a happy warmth deep inside. Helping Squeaky made her heart feel good. She knew it was true: Kind hearts make happy days!
slides.speaker_notes: Squeaky Squirrel thanks Bella Bear warmly, and Bella feels happy and fulfilled after helping her friend.
